prompt: Website for Arden & Wells, a small management consultancy helping manufacturing companies cut costs, with services, results in numbers, the team and a contact form

data.title: Lower your plant costs without cutting what makes your product good
data.subtitle: Arden & Wells is a small consultancy that helps manufacturing companies find savings in energy, scrap and downtime, and keep them. Practical work done on the shop floor, not in slide decks.

data.title: Trusted by manufacturers across the Midlands

features.title: Cost diagnostic
features.description: Two weeks on site mapping where money leaks: energy, scrap, changeovers and maintenance. You get a ranked list of fixes with expected savings.

features.title: Lean implementation
features.description: We work alongside your team to put the changes in place, train supervisors and measure results every week.

features.title: Supplier negotiation
features.description: Benchmarking and structured negotiation with your top suppliers, based on real market data.

features.title: Ongoing support
features.description: A monthly review to keep the gains, spot drift early and plan the next round of improvements.

data.title: Results our clients see
data.subtitle: Average across projects completed in the last three years.

data.title: The people you will work with
data.subtitle: Former plant managers and engineers, not career consultants.

testimonials.quote: They found savings we had walked past for years, and they stayed until the changes stuck. The first-year return paid for the project twice.
testimonials.author: Graham Hartley

testimonials.quote: Honest, practical and respectful of our operators. The team felt helped, not audited.
testimonials.author: Sophie Calder
testimonials.role: Operations manager, a precision engineering firm

data.title: Let us look at your numbers
data.subtitle: Tell us about your plant and the biggest cost you would like to understand. We reply within one working day with next steps, and the first call is free.

data.description: Operations consultancy for manufacturers. Birmingham, United Kingdom.
